Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our vendor due diligence and SIG intake, our security team needs a current list of Redwood's subprocessors and third-party services. Specifically we need: 

- A single roster (CSV or spreadsheet) listing each provider, the services they deliver (e.g., compute, storage, telemetry, support), and whether they handle customer data or only metadata.

We will also request SOC 2 or equivalent evidence for the larger providers, but the immediate priority is the roster + mapping. Can you provide this by end of week?

Soojin / Evelyn — attaching a first-pass CSV (vendor_inventory_20260219_draft.csv). Below are the main vendors I included and the short category assignments: 

1) Amazon Web Services (AWS) — compute, storage (S3), networking; customer data at rest in S3 for optional object storage.
2) Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — BigQuery (analytics), Pub/Sub (messaging), backup buckets in specific projects.
3) Cloudflare — CDN / reverse-proxy; edge config; does not persist customer payloads.
4) Datadog — telemetry / metrics / APM; has host and application traces (no PII by default).
5) Sentry — error tracking; stores event-level metadata.
6) Segment / Rudderstack — analytics event routing; used for diagnostics and product analytics.
7) Zendesk — support ticketing; contains customer-submitted text and email addresses.
8) Intercom — in-app messaging / chat; stores conversation transcripts.
9) GitHub — code hosting; repo access limited to staff; no customer data retention.
10) CircleCI — CI/CD; stores logs and artifacts.
11) HashiCorp Vault — secrets management (self-hosted/managed); required for key storage.
12) Okta — identity provider (SSO).
13) Google Workspace — corporate email and docs; contains internal customer communications when shared.
14) Snowflake — analytics warehouse for aggregated telemetry (no raw customer PII in current pipelines).

A few items: 
- I marked Datadog and Sentry as "monitoring/telemetry" with a note to request data retention limits.
- For AWS/GCP, I included the region/country columns where our primary projects are located.
- I excluded open-source libs and public packages.

Attachments: vendor_inventory_20260219_draft.csv (stub)

Next steps: Evelyn, once you confirm the SIG-section mapping I will finalize the CSV and add country/subprocessor details where available.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
